correctness.rationale: Any automorphism is monomial because the independent squares force disjoint supports; its permutation must rotate the directed cycle. The exact scalar recurrence closes with (2^n-1)x0+2^j v-u=0 mod 3, yielding exactly one or two isomorphism classes, and all automorphism orders. In the twisted even class the explicit two-step lift phi satisfies phi^(n/2)=delta of order three, so generates the whole cyclic group and proves the nonsplit criterion. Simplicity follows from ideal propagation, idempotents from an exact cyclic power equation. Standalone exhaustive tests of all 3279 coefficient vectors for dimensions 1..7, plus direct idempotents for dimensions <=5, passed.

value.rationale: This is a uniform infinite classification within Question 33 of the October 2026 survey, not one disconnected small case. Over the minimal field having cube roots of unity, it exhibits an infinite family of simple single-cycle-support algebras with nonsplit automorphism extensions and gives the sharp divisibility cutoff n divisible by six, plus the split complement and idempotent dichotomy. These explain how finite-field parity and cubic torsion drive extension behavior.
